description: This file defines a mock implementation of a cache service used for testing purposes within the OrangeHRM project. It extends the CacheService class and provides a static method to return a new ArrayAdapter instance, which is part of the Symfony Cache component.

classes.name: MockCacheService
classes.description: A mock cache service class for testing, extending the core CacheService and providing a static method to retrieve cache instances.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Returns a new ArrayAdapter instance for caching, allowing an optional namespace parameter.
